comment: The source defines an Input normalization submenu for the CV2 input and a Filter out identical notes (experimental) item, but neither is added to any menu in the installed build, so no line covers them. The CV2 normalization on this module is the NORM knob on the panel. The clock input is read as a clock edge, or as a tempo CV of two to the power of volts when the BPM CV option is on (NoteEcho.cpp:441-443), so what it expects depends on that setting.
